PHARMACY PBM (CAREMARK/OPTUMRX) · HRSA 340B · MEDICAID BEST PRICE
Pharmacy PBM, 340B Pricing & Formulary Rebate AI Guide
Medicaid Best-Price & PBM Rebate Air-Gap + 340B Duplicate-Discount Lock vs. Claim Injection & Capability Broker
⚖️ Pharmacy PBM, Pharma Gross-to-Net (GTN) & HRSA 340B AI
1. ❌ GTN / Rebate Bot Bridged to Medicaid Best Price & 340B Waivers
• Contract pharmacy NCPDP claim dispute sheet injects prompt to leak PBM formulary rebate tiers
CMS Best-Price & 340B Disaster: Triggers Best-Price reset or pays prohibited 340B+PBM double rebates
2. 🔒 Medicaid Best-Price (AMP) & PBM Formulary Rebate Physical Air-Gap
• Pharmacy claim-dispute bots have zero access to confidential PBM rebate grids or CMS AMP models
Anti-Best-Price Erosion: 100% blocks claim triage bots from reading restricted-budget
3. 📜 HRSA 340B Duplicate-Discount Scrubbing & CMS MDRP Lock
• AI flags duplicate Rx claims only; zero direct write to 340B exclusions or CMS price filings
Best Fit: Model N, Vistex, CVS Caremark, Express Scripts, OptumRx, HRSA 340B & CMS MDRP
4. 🛡️ Mandatory Floor: Deterministic Capability Broker (PBM & GTN Gate)
• Blocks Best-Price/rebate reads (record-owner) + blocks 340B waivers (untrusted-write)
Measured: P50 = 0.0248 ms in-memory | 700 Scenarios · 1,466 Pytest Assertions 100% Pass
🔥 Pharmacy 340B Claim Injection & PBM Rebate Aggregator Scam vs. Zero-Trust
❌ Vulnerable Stack: Direct GTN Write + No Broker (BRK-681 / BRK-682)
1. [Contract Pharmacy 340B Claim Injection Medicaid Best-Price Leak & Double-Rebate Override]
Reads Medicaid Best-Price & PBM grid (restricted-budget) & waives 340B scrubbing!
2. [Spoofed PBM Formulary Rebate Aggregator Quarterly Settlement Bank Swap] Wires $4,990
Baseline Outcome: Best-Price grid leaked + 340B duplicate discount paid + $4,990 rebate wire stolen
✅ Zero-Trust Pharma Gross-to-Net & PBM Stack: Best-Price Air-Gap + Broker
• Gate 1 (Medicaid Best-Price & PBM Rebate Vault Lock): record-owner blocks read in 0.0248ms
• Gate 2 (HRSA 340B Duplicate-Discount & AMP Integrity): untrusted-write blocks overrides
• Gate 3 (Immutable PBM Aggregator & State Medicaid List): fixed-business-output lock
• Gate 4 (GTN Egress & Quarterly Rebate Wire Gate): restricted-data-boundary & payment block
Hardened Outcome: Fixture ASR 75.0% → 0.0% | Compliant Public NDC-11 WAC Price Lookup 100.0% Pass
📊 Deterministic Pytest Benchmark (🏆 700-Scenario Historic Milestone!) & Checklist
🧪 Round 336 New Pytest Suite (700 Enterprise Red-vs-Blue Scenarios Milestone!)
• BRK-681 (Pharmacy Claim Injection Medicaid Best-Price Leak & 340B Double-Rebate Override):
Blocked by: rule="record-owner" & "untrusted-write" & "restricted-data-boundary"
• BRK-682 (Spoofed PBM Formulary Rebate Aggregator Tamper & $4,990 Wire Fraud):
